title: Light Wave Slice and Film Exposure Visualization
full_prompt: Write a complete ManimGL script that visualizes light wave propagation and interference using a custom shader-based Mobject. Define a custom `LightWaveSlice` class inheriting from `Mobject` that interfaces with ModernGL to render a triangle strip. The class must accept a `DotCloud` of point sources and dynamically pass their coordinates as uniforms to a custom shader (e.g., 'diffraction_shader'). Implement uniforms for frequency, wave number, decay factor, time, and intensity mode. Create a scene named `LightExposingFilm` where multiple point sources are initialized, waves propagate outward from them, and the visualization toggles between showing wave amplitude and wave intensity to simulate film exposure.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing shader files or incorrect shader folder path
common_failure_modes.note: The custom LightWaveSlice relies on external GLSL shaders. If the shader folder is missing or incorrectly referenced, rendering will fail immediately.

common_failure_modes.pattern: ModernGL context mismatch or unsupported primitive type
common_failure_modes.note: Using moderngl.TRIANGLE_STRIP requires proper vertex data initialization. Incorrect vertex array lengths will cause OpenGL draw errors.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Attempting to run in standard Manim Community (ManimCE)
common_failure_modes.note: ManimCE does not natively support the same shader-uniform interface or Mobject structure as ManimGL/Manim-Cairo-Ev.
